rules.title: Bad and doubtful debts: 1 % of the revenue

clause.regulation: OERC (Terms and Conditions for Determination of Wheeling Tariff and Retail Supply Tariff) Regulations, 2022
clause.excerpt: 5.8.1 The commission shall allow a provision for bad debts as a pass through in the ARR as a prudent commercial practice in the revenue requirement of the licensee. The provision of bad and doubtful debts during the control period shall be allowed on normative basis of 1% of the total annual revenue billed for sale of electricity.
